paper_title: Search for sub-eV axion-like particles in a quasi-parallel stimulated resonant photon-photon collider with "coronagraphy"
coupling_convention: g/M in GeV^-1 (ALP-photon coupling g_agamma), as plotted on y-axis
notes: SAPPHIRES02 laser-based stimulated resonant photon-photon collider (four-wave mixing in vacuum) search for sub-eV ALPs. Null result; 95% CL exclusion regions set in the g/M vs m plane for both scalar and pseudoscalar ALPs (Figs. 10-11). Only one explicit numerical value is given in the text: the most sensitive point g/M = 5.45e-7 GeV^-1 at m = 0.15 eV for pseudoscalar ALPs; the full exclusion curve spans roughly 1e-3 to ~1 eV but is only shown graphically, so a single point is extracted. This is a purely laboratory bound, fully independent of cosmological/astrophysical assumptions — no DM density assumed.
